rationale: Boldyn Networks and the separate Boldyn Networks (US) record represent one manager-level neutral-host connectivity platform. Direct sources support CPP Investments and AIMCo as parent shareholders, Manulife Infrastructure Fund II as an asset-specific minority investor in U.S. digital infrastructure, and the 2025 U.S. capital raise as debt rather than equity.

repoReconciliation.preserveBoundary: one Boldyn platform; regional legal entities, Mobilitie, Transit Wireless, ZenFi, Signal Point, Apogee, venue and transit systems, projects and financing vehicles remain beneath it

proposalGuardrails: Keep task 0470 as the sole canonical Boldyn company and merge or redirect task 0471 beneath it.
Preserve CPP Investments' 86% and AIMCo's 10% as parent-level stakes at the last directly disclosed March 2024 date.
Preserve Manulife Infrastructure Fund II as a minority investor only in specified U.S. digital-infrastructure assets; do not represent it as a parent-level Boldyn shareholder.
Do not convert the 2025 US$1.2bn senior secured facilities and notes into equity ownership.
Do not create regional subsidiaries, acquired brands, operating systems, projects or financing entities as separate PortCos.
Do not infer the residual 4%, AIMCo entry date, Manulife percentage or 2024 follow-on instrument.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: Identity of the residual 4% parent interest
Amount and instrument of the March 2024 follow-on commitment
